title: ProjectSync
summary: Keep your MediaMake projects in the cloud from Claude: brand kits, productions, release kits and media, shared under each project's permissions. Needs your MediaMake API key.

install.notes: Claude Desktop asks for your MediaMake API key (MediaMake → API keys) when you install it. Cloud projects need community access or above. Setup: https://github.com/microfox-ai/mediamake/tree/main/packages/projectsync-mcp#setup
